description: Python dependencies through uv and GitHub Actions. Weekly, with minor and patch updates grouped; versions younger than ten days are left out, as uv's exclude-newer refuses them.

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates into one weekly pull request; majors stay individual.
pymumble-rev is 0.x and pinned exactly (ADR-001): a minor release may break its API, so it never rides in the weekly batch.
